cc:Work.dc:title: Hypothetical roofline with a 20 FLOP per byte ridge
cc:Work.dc:description: Ideal envelope for constructed capacities of 8 TFLOP/s and 400 GB/s. A at intensity 2 has roof 0.8 TFLOP/s; B at 20 and C at 64 have roof 8 TFLOP/s. No measured points.
